summary: A firmware that turns the FM-1 into a steel tongue drum played with both thumbs, with a koi pond animation reacting to each note. Built on Felucca and sharing its sketch storage with the sibling firmware Modular One.
features: Eleven tongues under each thumb, starting in C major
Six scales and four materials: steel, low drum, glass, wood
Strike, resonance and edge-bounce controls; dry sound, no reverb
Rolls, an octave harmonic and a self-playing 'rain' mode
Sketchbook and tape recorder shared with Modular One
Settings for key, MIDI channel, tuning, speaker and sleep
